text: Simple illustration of a dynamic digital image of a romantic scene between a man and a woman dressed in modern clothes, standing close to each other in a tropical forest, skyscrapers visible in the distance. Close-up: on the right, the picture shows a young man with dark hair styled in an elegant hairstyle, dressed in a black shirt and jeans. He stands facing the camera, with his hand on the woman's shoulder, and looks directly into the camera. He looks about twenty years old, he has a long, aristocratic face with a well-defined chin, deep-set eyes and a slightly open mouth. On the left side of the picture, a beautiful young woman with long red hair, dressed in an off-the-shoulder turquoise dress, stands with her hand on a man's shoulder and looks at him tenderly. She looks about twenty years old, has a slender build and fair skin. Background: twilight, a romantic atmosphere reigns in the jungle, thanks to soft lighting and details, and in the background you can see the tops of the skyscrapers of the megacity of the future. The atmosphere is harsh, gloomy, noir-style, with extensive scenic concept art with rich textures. Futuristic style, high-quality detailing, professional photography, depth of field, detailed natural skin texture.
